mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_consent WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consent_type = 'CHALLENGE' AND status = 1 AND withdrawn_at IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now}) )
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') FROM tbl_user_consent WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consent_type = 'CHALLENGE' AND status = 1 AND withdrawn_at IS NULL AND created_at < #{currentMonthStart}
